excluded.statement: The listed structures are the true global minima of their potential energy surfaces.
excluded.reason: requires a Minima Hopping search; only the ordering among supplied isomers is testable (al13m1-energy-ordering)
not defined in the paper text; which relaxed (N-1) structure was used is not stated

excluded.statement: Correlation trends across whole potential energy surfaces (Figs 2-7, 17-18).
excluded.reason: would need thousands of single points; not a per-claim re-verification

excluded.statement: Transition states, saddle points and disconnectivity graphs (Figs 8 and 16).
excluded.reason: needs saddle-point searches (minima hopping guided path search); not single-point or relaxation claims

excluded.statement: Density of states under random atomic displacements (Fig. 12).
excluded.reason: random displacements are not published, so the structures can't be reproduced

excluded.statement: Al12X substitution series other than Al12Si (Figs 19-20: Al12N^+1, Al12P^+1, Al12As^+1, Al12Sb^+1).
excluded.reason: these structures are not in the Materials Cloud record, so there is no structure authority

excluded.statement: Purely geometric descriptors of stored structures (coordination numbers, soft-sphere surface/volume, fingerprint distance, eccentricity).
excluded.reason: properties of the published geometries, not DFT results; nothing for BigDFT to recompute

needs_template.statement: Point group of the global minimum (Table 1 'Point group', e.g. Al13^-1 is Ih).
needs_template.suggested_quantity: point group of a BigDFT-relaxed geometry (needs a relax recipe and a symmetry-analysis template); the dataset used pymatgen point-group analysis with tol=0.0009

needs_template.statement: Average bond distance of the global minimum (Table 1).
needs_template.suggested_quantity: zeta-weighted pair-average bond distance of a relaxed geometry (verified formula: sum zeta_kl d_kl / sum zeta_kl)

needs_template.statement: Shape factor S (eqn 3) of relaxed geometries.
needs_template.suggested_quantity: inertia-tensor shape factor of a relaxed geometry

notes: Table 1 'KS DFT degeneracies' lists distinct degeneracy values (starred = approximate); Table 2 and the dataset list every occupied level in order. Compare with the dataset list.
Stored isomer order follows energy above the global minimum; in 22 systems KS-Final-energy is not strictly monotonic along that order.
Mg clusters use LDA in the paper; the prototype mapping has no LDA NLCC pseudopotential for Mg, so Mg claims are not offered.
Na and Ge have no pseudopotential in the prototype mapping, so Na and Ge claims are not offered.

Al12Si: the dataset stores 11 keys (no VIE, VEA, hardness or eigenvalue degeneracy); Table 1 gives its gap (2.00 eV) and hardness (2.73 eV). Al12Si claims are not in this profile version (the Si+Al pseudopotential pair is untested).
